source.source_title: Have I Told You Lately That I Love You?
source.why_this_clip: A white table clock radio with a square clock face on the left and a dark round dial on the right sits still on a shelf while the camera pushes in from a wide view to a close view. The radio itself does not move; the whole clip from 0.0 to 2.25 s has no cut, so the full clip is used.
